name: Page Category and Tag
author: iSmart Web Service

sections.description:
Page category & Tag adds Category and Tag support to WordPress pages, allowing you to organize and manage your pages just like posts. This plugin is perfect for websites with extensive page structures or those looking to enhance their content management capabilities.

Key Features:
– Enable category for pages.
– Enable Tag for pages.
– Seamless integration with the WordPress editor.
– Lightweight and easy to use.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/page-category-tag/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Edit any page, and you’ll see the Category and Tag meta boxes ready to use.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for Category and Tag on pages.
  • Integrated with the WordPress editor and REST API.
